Source-free 20s periodic background overlaps fixed 45s grid exactly every lcm(20,45)=180sec, so 10 of 90 periodic events look like 45s clock hits with ZERO target. Shift background by +1s gives 0 of 90. Frozen original ABIDES hard-negative 45s fraction remains greater than positive TWAP.

Original genuine ABIDES 12 matching engine runs on 2901-2903: public 45s fraction fixed-20s background 0.08201092 (no target) > injected TWAP 0.03022026; legacy 10s 3/3 fixed-cadence false alarms and 3/3 missed TWAP despite 67 posthoc controlled fills. 12568 public executed prints/21675 L2 snapshots; negative specificity confirmed.

Six source-pinned genuine ABIDES matching simulations on seeds 2801/2802: fixed 10s public rhythm false positives 2/2 fixed-cadence background; missed both genuine injected 45s TWAP positives (29 posthoc controlled fills), Poisson null 0/2 alarms. Negative transfer confirmed.

Frozen 4-seed toy holdout: random-noise null 0/4 alarms, periodic non-target background 4/4 FALSE alarms, injected periodic target 4/4 hits; hard negative and positive public streams identical per seed. Real-market accuracy unknown.

One-command offline repro covers 14 explicit negative/unit suites, 113 passed source-free tests, 8 pinned aggregate provenance fixtures, no network or vendor raw data. Not a scientific detector release.
